hubs.title: Black Friday 2026 UK deals: every guide in one place
hubs.seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK Deals: Guides & Target Prices
hubs.description: Black Friday 2026 is on 27 November. Our brand-by-brand guides show what's already cheap, what to wait for and the prices worth paying.
hubs.intro:
**Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Cyber Monday is on 30 November.** UK retailers start cutting prices weeks before, but many 'deals' aren't real. Each guide below covers one brand or product. It shows what's genuinely cheap right now, last year's Black Friday prices, and the price worth waiting for.

We update these guides every few days through November, so the prices stay current.
